Home Our Dentists Our Services Contact Us About Us ABOUT US Dr. Dhanjal, DDS Dr. Dhanjal graduated from the Punjab Government Dental College in Amristar, India and has been practicing in Arizona since 1979. His favorite procedures are root canals, crowns and extractions. He is a genuine genereal dentist, and rarely refers out. During his free time, Dr. Dhanjal likes spending time with his grandchildren and gardening. ​ Dr. Gagandeep Kaur-Dhanjal, DMD, MPH Dr. Kaur is a mother of a beautiful little son, whom she loves to spend time with.  Dr. Kaur graduated from Baba Jaswant Singh Dental College in India in 2011, as a general dentist.  After serving in India as a general dentist for 2 years, Dr. Kaur moved to the United States where she completed her DMD (Doctor of Medicine in Dentistry) and MPH (Masters in Public Health) degrees at Arizona School of Dentistry and Oral Health in Mesa, Arizona.  Serving people in need has been the main motivation for Dr. Kaur coming into dentistry, is passionate and dedicated to her profession. ​ ​ ​   Dr. Shawn Dhanjal, DMD, MPH Dr. Shawn loves to spend time with his family.  He is a father of a beautiful little son.  During his free time he likes to play with his son, and play the numerous musical instruments that he knows.  His inspiration is his father (Dr. Dhanjal).  As a kid growing up in Phoenix, Arizona Dr. Shawn would observe his father in the dental office, and on numerous accounts see the wonderful impact that his father had on his patients and his community, through dentistry.  Dr. Shawn completed his Doctor of Medicine in Dentistry (DMD), and his Masters in Public Health (MPH), at Arizona School Of Dentistry and Oral Health in Mesa, Arizona.  Dr. Shawn loves general dentistry, and is dedicated to help people achieve their dental needs and goals.  ​ Shannon Davis, RDH ​ ​ About Us EMERGENCY DENTAL CARE WALK-INS WELCOME GENERAL DENTISTRY OUR SERVICES Routine Exams Dental Hygiene Fillings Dentures Emergency Dentistry Teeth Whitening Implants Orthodontics Root Canals Crowns Bridges Routine & Wisdom Teeth Extractions Our Services 39+ Years of Experience 6 Master Degrees OUR DENTISTS Dr. Sewa Dhanjal Dentist Dr. Shawn Dhanjal Dentist Dr. Gagandeep Kaur -
